headline: Mayor Joins Members to Discuss Communication, Vacancies, and Goals; Without a Quorum, No Votes Taken
summary: The group did not have enough members for a quorum, so it could not vote on chair selection or other items. The mayor attended to hear concerns about communication and workload after a hard year. Talk also covered filling open seats and the annual report, due by Monday.
discussion: Communication with the mayor: Members said messages went unanswered after July and asked for clearer contact and acknowledgment. The mayor said he would respond more quickly and asked staff to be copied on emails.

Recruiting new members: Members discussed low applicant interest, advertising through personal networks, and reaching a former applicant. The mayor's office receives applications, and the council liaison may announce vacancies at council meetings.

Annual goals and past work: Members listed past projects, including the public restroom review and work with other committees. They discussed goals such as attending city events and reaching residents more directly.
Holiday proclamation timing: Members said they were fine skipping a holidays and traditions proclamation this December because a vote was not possible at this meeting.
